title: crm.contact.opted_in v1
description: Emitted when a CRM contact opts in to communications. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-crm-go, staged via OutboxContactPublisher.OptedIn (internal/service/outbox_publisher.go:122-148) inside the contact-write transaction (HybridPublisher.OptedIn routes tx!=nil calls to the outbox, internal/service/hybrid_publisher.go:72-78; ADR-117 §9.B). The flat payload staged at insert time (contact_id/tenant_id/phone, outbox_publisher.go:134-138) is later wrapped by alebrije-common-go's outbox.Poller.buildEnvelope (poller.go:414-436) into the canonical envelope this schema describes: event_id = outbox row id, event_type = 'crm.contact.opted_in' (row.EventType verbatim), data = the staged flat payload verbatim. No schema previously existed for this event type at all (ErrNoSchema fail-open; validator currently inert fleet-wide — no schemas dir mounted in any deployed pod). DEBT-AUDIT-20260701-019-catalog-crm-agenda.

contact_id.description: UUID of the contact that opted in (c.ID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:135).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant (c.TenantID.String(), outbox_publisher.go:136; ADR-25). Redundant with the envelope-level tenant_id — present because the staged flat payload becomes 'data' verbatim.

phone.description: E.164 phone number of the opted-in contact (c.Phone, outbox_publisher.go:137).
